description: This file defines the 'WorkExperience' data transfer object (DTO) class used in the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates the work experience details of an employee and provides methods to convert this data into an array format, utilizing entity management and normalization traits.

classes.name: WorkExperience
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing an employee's work experience, capable of serializing employee work experience data into an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the employee's work experience to an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping from field names to their corresponding getter methods in the Employee entity.
